title: Northern public approach confirmation

bodyBlocks.text: The descriptor selects the linked-quarry reference. No hidden physical boundary needs to be found; the complete documentary evidence is carried in the case file.

North Quarry Picnic Area is the operator-listed public picnic setting at the northern end of Wallace Lake, off Valley Parkway north of North Quarry Lane. The operator’s directions target 41.364374, -81.856805, and list visitor parking. Use this northern approach, not the main beach destination.
bodyBlocks.title: Documentary reference · original paraphrase

bodyBlocks.text: Wallace Lake’s documented 1941 flooding joined two former sandstone quarries through a shallower channel. This is historical reference evidence, not a current visible seam or an instruction to approach water.
